styleLock.backgroundSystem: deep space-blue #1C3F94 starfield posters alternating with rounded light lavender-blue #E9EEF8 content cards and clean white #FFFFFF fields

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent interstellar sporty sneaker ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep space-blue #1C3F94, cloud light lavender-blue #E9EEF8, clean white #FFFFFF and one ice-blue accent #6FB7E8; cool-toned studio lighting with a soft upper-left key, soft fill and controlled contact shadows; italic athletic sans-serif typography with slanted headline energy; thin-line leader callouts with dot markers and rounded outline pill labels in a single accent color; clean high-end sneaker photography mixed with rounded-card infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle and scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 以规整参数卡收尾打消规格疑虑，空表格留待后期填充真实信息

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting, no dramatic shadow

shots.props: one rounded spec card with empty ruled rows and an empty size reference table

shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce trust and spec screen of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Top-down 90-degree overhead flat lay, the sneaker lying beside a rounded light lavender-blue #E9EEF8 spec card over a deep space-blue #1C3F94 frame. Even high-key flat lighting with no dramatic shadow. The card holds a two-column parameter list with empty ruled rows and a size reference table with blank cells, headed 「{callout_1}」 in deep space-blue #1C3F94, plus a small pill label 「{selling_point_1}」 near the product. Negative: do NOT invent brand names, size numbers, certifications or test data inside the table cells, no QR code, no member badge, no watermark, no fake logos, no dense body text, no crooked table rules.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：屏1为星空深蓝海报、鞋款悬浮呈 3/4 角度并配行星星光插画与拟人宇航员插画；屏2讲线条流畅与皮革网布拼接的说辞卡；屏3为侧视结构标注图（中底科技名与鞋跟膜材说法属不可验证宣称，已改 {callout} 占位）；屏4为双鞋斜排加双重面料信息卡；屏5为大底六边形纹路微距（外底含第三方品牌压印，已剥离）；屏6为鞋头网面放大圆加多色可选预告；屏7为 2x2 四鞋阵列（原标签仅两种且重复，已改为四个独立占位）；屏8为参数表（尺码区间与表内码段脚长数值互相矛盾，均不采信，表格留空）。品类判定：参数区款式写休闲跑鞋、成人尺码段、复古篮球鞋型厚底造型，判为鞋靴/运动鞋，leaf 定为复古篮球风厚底休闲跑鞋。已剥离：原品牌字与字标、大底第三方压印标、原平台店铺字样、会员徽标与二维码、宇航员角色插画、原文案原句、全部原尺寸数值；产品一律以 {product} 占位。
